'''Andrey Afrikanovich Rostovtsev''' ({{langx|ru|Андре́й Африка́нович Росто́вцев}}; born 21 March 1960) is a Soviet and Russian physicist and political activist. One of the founders of the volunteer community network [[Dissernet]].

== Biography ==
In 1983 graduated from the  [[National Research Nuclear University MEPhI (Moscow Engineering Physics Institute)|MEFI]]. After graduation worked with [[Institute for Theoretical and Experimental Physics|ITEPh]]: until 2013 - as Head of the Laboratory of Physics of Elementary Particles.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://pubmet.unizd.hr/pubmet2019/speakers/andrei-rostovtsev/|title= Andrei Rostobtsev|website=Pubmet2019}}</ref><ref>[https://inspirehep.net/authors/991164 Publication profile]</ref>

The area of professional interests is [[Particle physics]] and [[Neutrino astronomy]]. Andrey Rostovtsev is the author of several hundred papers on particle physics, one of the most cited Russian authors of papers on experimental physics at [[particle accelerator]]s. Member of the Corps of Physics Experts.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://expertcorps.ru/science/experts/branch/phys/all |title=Physics: all experts|language=ru}}</ref>

In 1997 he defended his doctoral thesis "Experimental study of hadron interactions of a photon using the H1 detector at the [[HERA (particle accelerator)|HERA accelerator]]".

In 2011, after ITEP was transferred under the control of the [[Kurchatov Institute]], published a number of critical statements in defense of the institute, against the dominance of incompetent representatives of the new administration and the bureaucratization of science in general. Together with Vladimir Uralov, he founded the Internet project "Save ITEP". For criticism of the administration of the institute, he was fired from ITEP at the end of 2013.<ref>{{cite journal|url=https://www.nature.com/articles/nature.2012.9921|title=Russian physicists protest government consolidation|date=January 27, 2012|journal=[[Nature (journal)|Nature]]|author=Geoff Brumfiel|doi=10.1038/nature.2012.9921 |s2cid=154009239 |url-access=subscription}}</ref>

After his dismissal from ITEP, he started working at the RAS [[w:ru:Институт проблем передачи информации имени А. А. Харкевича РАН|Institute for Information Transmission Problems]], Laboratory "Quantum physics and information".

== Participation in international projects ==
* [[ARGUS (experiment)|ARGUS]] experiment at the [[DESY#DORIS|DORIS]] electron-positron collider.<ref>[http://argus-fest.desy.de/e33/index_eng.html Argus members]</ref>
* Fundamental Research in High Energy Physics H1.<ref>[http://h1.desy.de/ Fundamental Research in High Energy Physics H1&#91;5&#93;]</ref>
* [[ANTARES (telescope)|ANTARES]] Neutrino observatory.<ref>[http://antares.in2p3.fr/Collaboration The ANTARES Collaboration]</ref>

== Dissernet ==
In February 2013, Rostovtsev, together with journalist [[Sergey Parkhomenko]], biologist [[Mikhail Gelfand]], and physicist [[Andrey Zayakin]], founded the volunteer community network [[Dissernet]], which exposes fake dissertations. Rostovtsev developed key software for dissertation and publication verification system.<ref>{{cite news |last=Khvostunova|first=Olga | date=May 8, 2013 | title = Plagiarism-gate | url   = http://imrussia.org/en/society/453-plagiarism-gate | publisher= Institute of Modern Russia}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last=Bowring|first=Bill|url=http://opendemocracy.net/od-russia/bill-bowring/putins-dissertation-and-revenge-of-runet|title=Putin's dissertation and the revenge of RuNet |date=May 23, 2014|publisher=[[openDemocracy]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last=Von Bidder|first=Benjamin|url=http://www.spiegel.de/spiegel/print/d-92079493.html|title=Wladimir Guttenberg|work=[[Der Spiegel]]|issue=16|date=April 15, 2013|accessdate=2013-08-12|language=de}}</ref>

In 2018 Andrey Rostovtsev entered the commission of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]], known as the Commission for Counteracting the Falsification of Scientific Research. He was the initiator and leader of the work for discovering translation plagiarism in the papers of Russian authors in foreign predatory journals that formed the basis of the corresponding Report of the Commission in 2020.<ref>{{cite web|author= |title=Report of the Commission of the Russian Academy of Sciences on combating the falsification of scientific research on predatory journals and translation plagiarism|url=http://www.ras.ru/news/shownews.aspx?id=24971447-ebfb-47b5-a3c2-9d26d467dac1|language=ru}}</ref>
